parent_objective: audit offtrack target and collision guardrail materialization
blocked_by: M2298 materialized target/guardrail slices and repair_gate_spec

public_gates: M2299 must not rerun reset or rollout
M2299 must verify M2298 target and guardrail counts
M2299 must verify profile axes are excluded from target and guardrail slices
M2299 must decide the next non-ranking route
M2299 must not rank profiles, select a winner, or claim paper/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits materialized target/guardrail slices and repair gate spec before any repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit and route selection only; no rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2298 target/guardrail counts fail
stop if profile axes leaked into target or guardrail slices
stop if repair_gate_spec is missing or incoherent
stop if no non-ranking follow-up route can be selected
fallback_plan: route to threshold repair if materialization counts fail
route to guarded repair design if target/guardrail materialization is accepted
route to branch synthesis if target and guardrail objectives conflict

training_stage.stage_objective: audit target/guardrail materialization and choose next route
admission_evidence: M2298 profile_target_slice_count and profile_guardrail_slice_count are zero
allowed_updates: M2299 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by audit
next_stage_criteria: target/guardrail materialization is accepted or rejected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2299 audits task-performance target materialization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2299.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat materialized target/guardrail slices as repair infrastructure, not self-ID evidence.

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits explicit repair targets before repair execution
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit guarded repair design or force scenario-task reshaping
must_synthesize_if: M2299 cannot select a non-ranking route
M2299 recommends broad repair without using target/guardrail gates
M2299 finds target and guardrail objectives conflict

hypothesis: M2298 target/guardrail materialization can be audited to admit a guarded repair design without rerun, ranking, or paper/self-ID claims.
success_criteria: M2298 target and guardrail counts are verified
profile target and guardrail counts are verified as zero
a non-ranking follow-up route is pre-registered
failure_criteria: M2299 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2299 changes scenario specs or profile configs
M2299 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2299 cannot select a next route

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual result audit over runs/m2298_paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_offtrack_primary_collision_guardrail/summary.json and repair_gate_spec.json

decision_rule: M2299 passes if it verifies M2298 materialization and pre-registers a non-ranking follow-up route.
